CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Quote_Type__c, "Recontract"), IF( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Type__c, "Due Payment"), (Gross_Total1__c + Amount__c) * Tax__c, (Gross_Total1__c - Amount__c) * Tax__c ), Gross_Total1__c * Tax__c )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This formula calculates the adjusted gross total based on the type of quote and payment type, applying tax accordingly.
CustomField.label: Tax Amount
